title: Working date
description: The year an upstream record (a mine, quarry or deposit) is known to have been worked by, from a cited work (ADR 0051). Used instead of the year its dataset gives, which the app shows beside it; upstream sources are never edited.

occurrence.description: The upstream record: its dataset and its id there (MRDS's dep_id, or the number in a Pleiades place's address).

worked_by.description: The year it is known to have been worked by: worked then or earlier.

reason.description: What the work says that dates it, in a sentence.
